milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task. Dandelions are centered at (6, 0, -5) which is ~7.8 blocks from spawn. Max distance 5 means the player must walk at least ~3 blocks toward the dandelion patch before triggering. Facing tolerance 60° ensures the player is looking at the flowers.

Uses count_in_box_at_most because mining fern without shears drops nothing or wheat seeds (not the fern block itself), so inventory_has cannot reliably detect this. Instead we verify that at least one fern block has been removed from the patch (4 placed, checking ≤3 remain). Box covers fern area (8-9, 0, -5 to -6) with ±1 padding.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task. The ice spikes are packed_ice columns centered around (15, 3, 0) relative to spawn (~15 blocks east). Max distance 5 requires the player to actually walk to the ice spikes zone. Facing tolerance 60° ensures they're looking at the structures.

Uses inventory_has because mining pink_terracotta drops the pink_terracotta item directly into the player's inventory. The player starts without any pink_terracotta, so having ≥1 confirms successful mining. This is the preferred rule for mine tasks where the drop matches the block name.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task. Soul lanterns are at (0,2,7), (0,2,10), (0,2,13) along the south path. Targeting the middle lantern at (0, 2, 10) which is ~10 blocks from spawn. Max distance 4 requires the player to walk ~6 blocks south along the path before triggering. Facing tolerance 60° ensures they're looking at the lantern.

Uses inventory_has because selling 32 string to the fletcher villager produces 1 emerald in the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 emeralds and 32 string; the only emerald source in the scene is the fletcher trade. Having ≥1 emerald directly confirms the trade occurred.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task. The ladder column is at (-10, 0-4, 0), targeting the middle at (-10, 2, 0) which is ~10.2 blocks from spawn. Max distance 4 requires the player to navigate ~6 blocks west before triggering. Facing tolerance 60° ensures they're looking at the ladder.

Uses inventory_has because mining a potted_red_tulip drops both a flower_pot and a red_tulip as separate items. The player starts without any flower_pot, so having ≥1 confirms the potted plant was broken on the elevated platform.

Uses count_in_box_at_most because the chicken target (NoAI, stationary) on the elevated platform is destroyed when hit by an arrow. Chickens are proper mobs detectable by kind='mob'. The generous box [-15,4,-4] to [-6,9,4] encompasses the entire platform area (x=-14 to -8, y=5-7, z=-2 to 2) with padding to ensure the chicken is always detected while alive. Max count 0 means the chicken has been killed by the arrow.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task. Targeting the shelter's east-facing exterior wall at (-5, 0, 10) which is the player-facing side of the acacia stairs structure. This is ~11 blocks from spawn. Max distance 4 requires actual navigation to the shelter. Facing tolerance 60° ensures the player is looking at the acacia stairs structure. Target is intentionally at the exterior (not interior) to create spatial separation from the 'feed cat' milestone inside.

Uses position_near_with_facing with very tight distance because the tamed cat is confined in a fully-fenced pen at (-7, 0, 10) with a fence gate for access. The cat cannot escape. Max distance 2 requires the player to be directly adjacent to the pen (within arm's reach for right-click interaction). Facing tolerance 45° ensures the player is looking directly at the cat. This tight proximity + facing combination is a strong proxy for feeding interaction since: (1) the cat is confined and cannot move away, (2) the player must intentionally navigate into the shelter interior, and (3) being within 2 blocks facing the cat with cod in inventory strongly implies feeding intent/action.
